answer_1.quote: This paper introduces a new end-to-end generation task, Interactive Text Generation, that accounts for interactivity without requiring real users during training.
answer_1.outputs: text that is tied to user needs, specifically article summaries

answer_2.quote: We evaluated generation using BLEU, CHRF BLEURT, BARTSCORE, and ROUGE.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation (Table) to compare interactive and noninteractive generation, similar to the automatic evaluation in Figure. We selected the best-performing model (BART Large) and compared 3-episode generation against 1 episode on 1k test instances. Each instance was evaluated by 5 mechanical turkers.
answer_4.guideline: The judges were asked to compare each pair of generations based on semantic similarity to the gold text ("meaning") and linguistic quality ("fluency") using a 5-point Likert scale.
